overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Kuusamo Edition 6 Person Indoor Traditional Sauna offers a luxurious and spacious retreat for relaxation and wellness. Designed for indoor or covered exterior use, this sauna combines the natural beauty of Canadian Hemlock and Red Cedar with advanced features like an 8.0 kW stove and an interior chromotherapy lighting system. Enjoy the benefits of muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation while listening to your favorite tunes via the built-in FM station and Bluetooth connection. Ideal for basements or fitness rooms, this sauna provides a serene escape with its clear tempered glass door and performance speakers, making it a perfect addition to your home wellness routine.

Product Ad-Copy: With a Golden Designs indoor or (exterior covered from direct weather elements) traditional sauna, you can turn that dream of your very own home spa into a reality. Even where space is at a premium, you can still enjoy the good life in the form of a delightfully relaxing and invigorating sauna in the comfort of your own home.

Planning a sauna as part of your new home or a renovation project is simple. Golden Designs offers several different prefabricated saunas to fit in the space you desire. Golden Designs saunas can fit into a multitude of spaces ranging from any compact home-bathroom to large open area in your bedroom, as well as exclusive facilities for hotel suites or corporate representation.
Golden Designs traditional saunas bring a healthier way to live. Enjoy the wealth of health benefits a traditional sauna brings to your life. Take the first step to a healthier life!
